summary: Ituran Location and Control Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share, totaling approximately $10 million for Q2 2026. The record date is September 29, 2026, with payment on October 14, 2026, net of 20% withholding tax under Israeli tax rules. Retained earnings will drop from $238.7 million to $228.7 million post-distribution. The board approved the dividend after confirming the company meets Israeli law distribution criteria. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation.
